acceptance_criteria: Frozen tool, M1R source OBJ, manifest, seal, container, plugin and E1 environment identities all match.
The analytic box passes exact raster/ring/frame reconstruction, repeatability and frozen range thresholds before Cano loading.
Exactly 24 preselected train-only poses produce 24 CPU references and 72 post-warm-up Gazebo scans, with 8/8/8 role balance.
Every pose independently passes exact repeat masks, repeat max difference <=0.0011m, valid agreement >=0.98, MAE <=0.05m, P95 <=0.10m, P99 <=0.25m and horizontal minimum difference <=0.10m.
Six fixed pages cover all 24 poses exactly once; pose map, analytic control and parent/role/elevation statistics preserve machine-readable provenance.
Complete within 3600 seconds and 1 GiB; formal data, labels, training, models, trajectories, online graph and M-TARE changes remain zero.
baseline: Closed-form axis-aligned box ranges validate frame, ring, azimuth, elevation, units and organized-cloud reconstruction before any Cano mesh is loaded.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only Open3D plus four fresh isolated Gazebo Classic gzserver sessions; no GUI, GPU or training.

expected_evidence: Frozen SDF worlds, exact pose manifest, 24 CPU references and 72 diagnostic Gazebo scans
Per-pose, parent, role and elevation metrics plus neighbour diagnostics
One pose map, one analytic figure, six complete parity pages and one distribution figure
Container/plugin/environment identities, raw logs, RUN_STATE and complete SHA-256 evidence seal
method: Run a closed-form box control, then compare Open3D CPU raycast against three warm-up-filtered Gazebo Classic CPU-ray repeats at 24 preselected poses on three sealed train-parent OBJ assets, enforcing every frozen per-pose threshold.
question: Can one frozen same-geometry, same-pose and same-ray CPU-to-Gazebo contract establish the sensor-domain mapping required before formal training data is created?
stop_conditions: Any analytic, source, environment, isolation, mesh import, pose, raster, repeat, parity, count, visualization, time, disk or seal check fails
Any retry, alternate parent/backend, pose replacement, threshold change, geometry conversion/repair or noise addition is required
